paragraphs: (The sons of Chovav, Moses’ father-in-law, Exodus 4:11.) Rav Yehudah bar Chaviva: Berakhot 41a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied Exodus 4:11 citation is preserved. Judges 4:11, in the Miqra digital text, names the descendants of Chovav, Moses’ father-in-law; the earlier comparison with Numbers 10:29 is also retained. The Exodus locator is not silently replaced.

The whole Miqra Judges 4:11 verse names descendants of Chovav, Moses’ father-in-law; the complete Davidson Berakhot 41a page, twelve whole paragraphs, is a bounded nonmatch for Rav Yehudah bar Chaviva. A separate whole Davidson Berakhot 42a:3 paragraph does name Rav Yehudah bar Chaviva. Hyman’s supplied Exodus 4:11 and Berakhot 41a locators and current mixed note remain verbatim; neither is silently repaired. The Rav title is locally supported without admitting an identity, kinship, or correction history.
